requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape character concept sheet for a new temple mage quest-giver in OUR OWN existing isometric fantasy survival/tower-defense game. This is an appearance proposal, not a screenshot of implemented gameplay.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is our original hero C: match its hand-painted cartoon volumes, clean dark contour, matte materials, restrained heroic proportions and elevated orthographic 3/4 camera. Image2 is our approved city: use ONLY its existing small pale-stone temple and quiet left-edge courtyard for a context vignette, preserving orange-roof surroundings and the silver ground teleport seal beside the temple. Do not redesign city architecture or make a new cathedral.
SUBJECT: one stern, calm adult male temple mage, a practical senior exorcist rather than a king or boss. Open weathered face, grey temples and short neat grey beard. Human scale, approximately the hero's height. Elongated but grounded silhouette, broad standing collar, warm ivory long traveling coat/robe with dark muted plum side panels, worn silver fittings, dark leather belt and boots. Limited broad silver embroidery, readable folds, no tiny noisy filigree. Closed bound book tucked under one arm. Other hand naturally grips a slender wooden staff with a SMALL silver lantern cage and warm ivory core. The staff glow is subtle and local. No giant aura. Full feet and grounded contact shadow.
LAYOUT: elegant neutral warm-grey parchment presentation, modest heading EXACTLY «ХРАМОВЫЙ МАГ». Large full-body elevated front-three-quarter view at left, smaller rear-three-quarter view in middle, both same character/costume. At right a framed temple-court vignette showing the NPC BESIDE the existing temple steps on free paving, clear of the portal seal and walking approach; include our small blue-coated hero nearby, at the SAME HUMAN body scale as the NPC. This vignette must show ordinary gameplay perspective, not a giant NPC. Keep staff and head safely inside margins. Space panels clearly, no overlapping bodies.
RENDERING: match the reference's painted illustrated sprite look, large softly shaded color planes, clear dark contour and legible silhouette. Serious fantasy tone, not photorealism, not anime, not cute/chibi. Readable ivory/plum mass distinct from the blue hero and cream temple. Natural hands and body anatomy.
CONSTRAINTS: no invented personal name, no city name, no «Хорад» or «Хород». No real-world religious emblems, pope hat, crown, wings, giant shoulder spikes, halo, cyan portal magic, weapons on hero, extra NPC services, dialogue box, quest menu, floating icons, stats, prices, lore or reward text. Only the short heading and optional tiny caption «У храма»; no other text. Original artwork, no franchise characters or copied game designs.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape comparison concept sheet of TWO proposed open-world enemies, an ORC and an OGRE, for OUR OWN existing painted isometric fantasy survival/tower-defense game.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is our original hero C: preserve that exact hero as a small human scale comparator, with blue travelling coat, brown leather boots, olive trousers and dark tied hair. Match its painted cartoon volumes, clean dark contour, matte materials and elevated orthographic 3/4 perspective. Image2 is our own native gameplay screenshot: use it only for grassy ground, lighting, camera/readability and the small character footprint; DO NOT draw its HUD, resources, text or screens.
MAIN ROW: three complete grounded figures in a common elevated orthographic 3/4 view on ONE shared horizontal foot baseline: ORC, our unchanged HERO comparator, OGRE. Hero body height =1. Orc body height about1.2 and width about1.35 of hero. Ogre body height about1.7 and width about1.9 of hero. Keep this comparison visible; do not resize ogre down to match other figures. All complete feet, hands, heads and weapons safely inside margins.
ORC: dangerous alert grounded fighter, broad trapezoid shoulders, strong long forearms, smoke-olive skin with lighter painted planes, strong lower jaw and TWO short ivory lower tusks, restrained dark hair. Rust-red coarse cloth, dark leather and ONE plain grey iron shoulder guard. Simple compact single-bladed iron axe lowered beside the body, naturally gripped. Clear combat silhouette, serious expression, not comedic. Avoid tiny armor clutter, oversized axe, horns, skull piles or glowing eyes.
OGRE: clearly heavier alternative, wide pear-shaped mass, powerful large hands and feet, small head and short neck; warm grey clay-colored skin, not another green orc. Rough brown leather cross-strap and dark waist cloth, simple heavy wooden branch club resting low beside body. Thick but believable limbs and joints. Menacing tired heavy expression, no goofy smile; not a giant boss, no elaborate crown/armor. Club is a silhouette proposal, not an announced attack mechanic.
PRESENTATION: quiet neutral warm-grey parchment background, broad matte softly shaded painted volumes, clean dark readable edges like heroC, original stylized game art. Modest headings only «ОРК», «ГЕРОЙ», «ОГР» placed with their figures. Lower quarter contains one separate small in-world preview strip on OUR grassy ground showing the same three bodies from the game camera at much smaller tactical scale, same relative sizes and clear space between silhouettes. This is an illustrative concept strip, not native verification. No other people.
CONSTRAINTS: these are alternatives for world exploration enemies, not portal skeleton replacements; no undead corruption, gore, blood, magic auras, factions, camps, landscape redesign, stats, ability icons, loot, quests, rank/level text or UI. No photorealism, anime, chibi, franchise trademarks or copied characters. One coherent sheet, generous margins, no collage clutter.
